purpose: Teach: キャサリン/永田町/シェリー/ビクター/ディーン/クラッチ/ハンス/マルタ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがキャサリン妃の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you that picture book about Princess Catherine.
lines.style: Warm, slightly knowing. Soft opening. Lets the sentence breathe. A gentle tease in the voice—affectionate observation, not judgment. Trails off with a hint of smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと永田町の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I already looked at a picture book with Dad about Nagatacho!
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo. Small laugh underneath—proud that he already did the thing. Slightly impatient to tell his own story. Natural kid energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがシェリー酒の歴史本を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you that book about the history of sherry, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle surprise in the lift. Warm and present. Slight wonder in her tone—noticing what he's learning, what his dad shares with him. Tender observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとビクター犬のロゴ見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw the Victor dog logo with Dad too!
lines.style: Quick excitement. Overlapping her words slightly. Wants her to know he's been discovering things. Small-boy urgency. Genuine delight in the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジェームス・ディーンの映画を観せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to show you a James Dean film.
lines.style: Reflective, almost dreamy. Soft attack. Pacing slow and deliberate. Slight wonder—she's imagining it, picturing him watching. Voice full of quiet affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと自転車のクラッチもどき遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I played this bike-clutch game with Dad!
lines.style: High energy, almost tumbling over the words. Bright laugh in the chest. Wants her full attention on this discovery. Boy-pure joy. Fast, animated.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハンスの童話を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you that Hans Christian Andersen story.
lines.style: Settled, knowing. Quiet certainty. She's been here before—watching him discover things with his father. Tender voice. Almost singing the end of the line.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとマルタ騎士団の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about the Knights of Malta with Dad!
lines.style: Breathless with accomplishment. Quick words, bright eyes in the voice. Wants immediate validation. Proud of himself. Genuine warmth toward her—she's his witness.
